lines.text: Two angels arrive at Sodom in the evening, and Lot persuades them to enter his house, where he prepares a feast.
The men of Sodom surround Lot's house, but the two men inside pull Lot in and strike the crowd with sickness.
The angels tell Lot to get his family out, and when he hesitates, they lead them safely out of the city.
Lot is told to flee to the mountains, but he asks to flee to a small town, and he reaches Zoar.
The LORD rains down sulfur and fire on Sodom and Gomorrah, and Abraham sees smoke rising like smoke from a furnace.
